messages:
Alex M: Quick async check for Q2 milestone handoff — short status: what shipped, what slipped, owners, and action items.
Sophia L: Shipped: routing-policy v1 -> canary (10%); KV-cache optimization landed in runtime; docs updated on Console.
Kai W: FYI the canary is seeing a 3% higher p95 on long tails, but throughput is up. Observability dashboards added.
Jordan P: Slipped: private deploy onboarding (customer A) — blocked on KMS integration and network egress rules. Owner: Jordan.
Alex M: Owner clarifications: Jordan owns KMS ticket, Sophia to help with egress rules template, Kai to validate telemetry after KMS is working.
Samira R: Code-review pings: PRs needing review: #4287 (KV-cache GC fix) @Sophia L, #4292 (canary routing fallback) @Kai W. Please quick-turn, blockers if any.
Sophia L: Reviewing #4287 today, should be green. Small comment left about test coverage.
Kai W: I'll take #4292 after standup. If fallback logic needs change, will tag infra-bot for deploy gate.
infra-bot: Deploy check: canary routing change passes static policy, but flagged for manual approval due to p95 delta > 2%.
Alex M: Decision: keep canary at 10% until p95 stabilizes. Rollforward plan: run canary for 2 business days, if p95 delta < 1.5% we scale to 50%.
Jordan P: KMS task timeline: dependency ticket created (ENG-792). Need security review — @Samira R can you own the review or point to SME?
Samira R: I can do initial review by EOD tomorrow. If heavy crypto changes, will hand to Security.
Alex M: Open dependency list for next week: 1) KMS & network (Jordan) 2) Security review (Samira) 3) Canary perf tuning (Kai) 4) Docs + customer comms (Sophia).
Sophia L: For customer comms, I can draft an email and support note once KMS timeline confirmed.
Kai W: Perf tuning note: trying diag flag --kv-cache-v2-debug on staging. If you see errors, paste logs here.
Samira R: Small ask: add explicit rollback steps to the runbook for routing-policy change. Current runbook assumes autoscale only.
Alex M: Agreed — Sophia, can you add rollback bullets and a short checklist to Console runbook?
Sophia L: On it. Will push a docs change and ping this thread when done.
Alex M: Final ask: please drop quick status updates here by EOD Friday. We want a clean rollforward plan for next week. :thumbsup:
Jordan P: Will update ENG-792 today with exact KMS vendor steps.
Kai W: Will post staging perf snapshot after tests.
Sophia L: Docs PR up in ~2 hours, will ping for review.
Samira R: Security review scheduled tomorrow 10am PT — invite sent.
Alex M: Thanks all — short and visible. If anything blocks immediate CI or customer onboarding, call it out here and we'll escalate.
